description:
The complete measurement of one portfolio in a single call: how many
        independent bets it holds, which holding carries risk out of line with
        its money, the companies owned through its funds (with how much of the
        money that view covers), what past crises did to it in money and how
        long it took to come back, and the numbered report. Each part is also
        available on its own, faster: portfolio_structure, look_through,
        past_crises, portfolio_report. Descriptive: no forecast, no advice.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

name: measure_portfolio

outputSchema.description: The full measurement of one portfolio.

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

lookthrough.description: What the portfolio owns through its funds.

covered_fraction.description: Share of the money whose underlying holdings are visible, 0 to 1.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

duplicated_exposure.description: Share held more than once through different funds.

exposures.description: [company, share of the whole portfolio] pairs, largest first.

opaque.description: Holdings with no breakdown to look through.

refused.description: Funds whose breakdown the data vendor refused.

top_symbol_weight.description: Its share of the whole portfolio.

report.description: The numbered report: every figure beside its method.

facts.description: One entry per figure: id, label, value, method, window, limit.

markdown.description: The report as markdown, figures numbered F1, F2…

receipt.description: A short plain-text receipt of the same figures.

stress.description: What past crises did to this mix, replayed on its holdings.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

limited_by.description: The holding whose short history limits the window.

recovery_days.description: Days to recover the previous peak; null if not yet.

status.description: Whether the holdings' history covers it.

window_start.description: First date all holdings have prices.

structure.description: How many independent bets the holdings add up to and who carries the risk.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

effective_bets.description: Effective number of independent bets (from correlations, not the ticker count).

max_risk_contribution.description: That holding's share of the risk, 0 to 1.

max_risk_ticker.description: The holding carrying the largest share of the portfolio's risk.

max_weight.description: Its share of the money, 0 to 1.

recent.description: The same figures over the recent years only.

top_factor_share.description: Share of the movement explained by the single strongest common factor.

title: Measure a portfolio
